text:
Priya: :rotating_light: incident-mux heartbeat flipped to STALE ~09:12 ago; incident-bot hasn't issued any pages for recent alerts. Seeing fanout errors + customer latency spikes on /api/generate. Starting triage now.

incident-bot: [system] deliver_attempts=3 schedule=\"sre-oncall\" result=HTTP_502 paging-proxy (x-retry=3)

Alex: can you paste the mux error log lines? any stack traces or http codes?

Priya: logs show connection timeouts and rpc deadlines. snippet:
```
2026-03-18T18:02:11Z mux_error: dial tcp 10.11.12.13:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-18T18:02:13Z fanout: rpc deadline exceeded (2.1s) to paging-proxy
2026-03-18T18:02:14Z deliver: upstream 502 (bad gateway)
```

Maya: support seeing 3 customer tickets for 504s and long waits. CS is holding on a bridge; customers asking if we're aware.

Jorge: I'm oncall but didn't get a page. Please manual-SMS me while you debug.

Priya: @Jorge sending manual SMS + Slack DM now. Also temporarily posting to #incidents.

Sam: plan: failover mux traffic to incident-mux-standby and restart deployment. will run rolling restart then monitor delivery success.
Commands I'll run:
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deploy incident-mux-standby --replicas=1
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/incident-mux
```

Alex: while restarting, add a fallback routing rule to avoid paging-proxy path for 5m. Patch configmap to force direct-sms route.

Priya: applying quick patch to routing policy (manual override).

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: Incident Mux failure -> steps: 1) scale standby 2) restart primary 3) validate deliver_success > 95% 4) notify customers. Link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/mux-failover

Sam: restart in progress. pods terminating and recreating. I'll watch logs for deliver_success metric.

Priya: manual SMS to Jorge confirmed delivered. Jorge acknowledged.

Jorge: Received SMS and Slack DM. I acknowledge, will monitor pager health and customer impact.

Sam: rollout finished. new pods up (3/3 ready). initial health checks green. logs show deliver_success counts rising.

incident-bot: [system] pages_delivered=18 pages_failed=0 to schedule=\"sre-oncall\" (since 3498765900)

Maya: CS updated customers; two tickets set to "we're remediating" and will get follow-up.

Priya: severity declared P1, invoking incident channel, bridging with CS and SRE. Immediate mitigation done (fallback + restart). Next: RCA on why paging-proxy returned 502 and why bot didn't surface failure to alerting.

Alex: potential action items: add alert on consecutive deliver_attempts > 2, add heartbeat metric for incident-bot->paging-proxy, and circuit-breaker telemetry.

Priya: thanks all. I'll kick off a postmortem and assign owners for the fixes. Please add any notes to the thread.

Jorge: monitoring 10m more, then hand off to next oncall. all good for now :+1:

Priya: closing live triage, leaving P1 open until RCA and follow-up fixes are scheduled.
